rule.en: Good rules keep everyone safe and happy.
rule.cn: 好的规则让每个人都安全又快乐。

don't.en: Don't forget to bring your books tomorrow.
don't.cn: 别忘了明天带上你的书。

should.en: You should listen carefully when the teacher speaks.
should.cn: 老师讲话时你应该仔细听。

run.en: We should not run in the school hall.
run.cn: 我们不应在学校走廊里跑。

shout.en: It's not polite to shout in the library.
shout.cn: 在图书馆里大声喊是不礼貌的。

walk.en: Walk on the right side of the hall, please.

hall.en: There are many posters on the wall of the hall.
hall.cn: 走廊的墙上有很多海报。

safe.en: Rules help us to stay safe at school.
safe.cn: 规则帮助我们在学校保持安全。
